nom: Lancôme Galatée Confort Comforting Milky Creme Cleanser

avis.titre: I will keep buying this product
avis.texte: I love everything about this cleanser and will keep using it. I love how well it removes makeup, how silky it feels, how it smells! I actually look forward to using it.
Lancome I hope you never discontinue this product. Its my favorite 💕

This is the best makeup remover out there. It takes off even long wearing makeup and does not feel greasy or uncomfortable. It is fragranced, which I personally love, but if you prefer a fragrance free product, you might not like this one.

I can't believe Lancôme is discontinuing this facial soap, I tried to order on their website not available it says, I was so HAPPY to see this on your Ulta website, I have been using this soap for 25 years, after I use this up I'll have to find a new soap thank you ULTA for carrying it

avis.titre: Waste of money. Didn't cleanse OR remove makeup
avis.texte: This didn't remove my makeup. There was a cream and makeup residue left after washing with this. And it didn't remove my eye makeup! I was left with raccoon eyes. I'll be going back to my beloved Korres face wash.

avis.titre: Been using for years!  Love it!
avis.texte: Happy with product, service & turn around time of my online order from Ulta.

I am a skin care specialist and was blown away the first time I used this product. It is amazing for older skin and helps with all the concerns older skin has. I highly recommend this product for anyone who wants to remove their makeup in the healthiest way possible.

avis.titre: No,sorry it's not good to my skin
avis.texte: It was fine to my skin. But it gave me more pimple .Makes me felt worry i don't know why?

avis.titre: What is with all the good reviews?
avis.texte: I do not wear a ton of make up and it's not often very hard to remove my makeup. I usually use the mouse radiance by Lancome and I decided to try this one for the winter time because my skin was a little drier. I could not get my make up to budge, especially my mascara!! I was left with smudgy, smeary raccoon eyes. So then I would put more of this cleanser on, try all over again and it still would not remove my make up. One time I even used a toner with cotton pads to see how much make up was left, and it was just alarming! Yuck. I wanted something gentle, but if it's not effective why bother? I would say the milky creaminess of this feels so good on your skin…. It is very soothing. So, that said, if you need something very gentle and don't wear make up or apply it extremely light? Then this might be for you. I am throwing away about 3/4 of this pump, and I feel like I've washed my money down the drain with the cleanser.

avis.titre: Good makeup remover, but not for eyes
avis.texte: I actually like this product since it only takes a pump or two to melt my makeup or SPF off my face before cleansing. The only issue (which is a dealbreaker for me) is that the formula seems to burn/irritate my skin and especially around the eye area. I was really hoping for this to be a great double cleanser/all around makeup remover but it really fell flat with the irritation. If Lancome reworked the formula to include eye area testing (in another question they stated they did not test this product for the eyes) that would be a GAME CHANGER. Personally. I think any makeup remover should at least not irritate the eyes.
I would rather have an un-scented product to clean my face. It broke me out in acne. Give it to your grandma

avis.auteur: Please do not include my name.
avis.titre: I !use this daily and won't be without it!  It's awesome!
avis.texte: This is a product to use every day. It is great for smooth skin.

This is a wonderful product for removing makeup. However, the sales person states that it also "cleans the skin" and therefore only one product is needed. It removes makeup but you will need to use a "cleanser" to get your face really clean.
I was really excited to use this cleanser but I don't feel like take my make up off very well. I have to use several pumps and tons of tissue.
I have used this product for years and love it! It does not require water, but I usually finish with a damp cloth to get the last bit off. My skin feels clean but not dry.

Performs so well and is so enjoyable to use, it makes removing makeup more of a pleasure than a chore. Works alone as a gentle, single step if no makeup was worn, or as a first step to very effectively break down makeup, even mascara, before cleanser. As with all things Lancome, Galatee Confort smells nice and feels luxurious, and even the beautiful bottle contributes to the sensory experience. Leaves skin feeling clean, dewy and yes, comforted. Tres bien!
Not a cleanser at all. It's a cream and the fragrance isn't appealing. Face feels filmy and not clean after using. Definitely will be returning.

I wasn't quite sure what to expect, but this actually does a GREAT job removing my foundation, leaves my skin feeling really soft. There is a slightly oily feel after using which actually seems to absorb in and has improved my over all oiliness in the last few weeks. And it smells lovely to me, slightly almond and slightly baby powder. And my pores look so much smaller which is a big deal for me.

This product takes two pumps to completely cover and remove make-up from face and neck, which is ok, but unfortunately it's not as thick as Lancome's Creme Mousse Confort. In my opinion, it takes much less Creme Mousse Confort compared to Galatée Confort Comforting Milky Creme Cleanser. Love the dispenser.

avis.titre: Incredibly gentle and works as described!
avis.texte: Really comforting and gentle, NON-irritating, doesn't burn my eyes, does not feel greasy, very refreshing. Works as described and great for sensitive skin.
face feels soft and clean afterwards. great for my sensitive skin!
I'm so in love! my face feels amazing after. worth the money!
I have used this product for years and I love the way it takes off my makeup. It leaves my skin smooth and hydrated, not dried out like soap dries my skin.
Use it EVERY time I wash my face! Miracle cream! Smooth and not heavy! Used it for years!

I've used the product for 20+ years. It does not break out my face and cleans off makeup, leaving skin moisturized. I love the smell. I know fragrance is not good but I don't think I've used one Lancôme product that does not smell good. I use my Clarisonic after with ultra gentle Neutrogena cleanser to do a thorough cleaning before applying treatments and moisturizer. I've tried other lower cost products but always come back to Galatee. A large bottle last me probably a year. Something I never plan to give up.

avis.titre: I always come back to it
avis.texte: I have been using this cleanser for so many years. I only stop using it because I like to venture and try new products. However, I always come back to this cleanser. I use an cleansing balm to remove my makeup and then I use this afterward. Sometimes I use it even if I don't wear makeup. It leaves my skin baby soft. It has mild and pleasant fragrance. I also use the toner and foaming face wash as well. A little pricey, but my skin is worth it.

Sensitive/Combination Skin Acne and blackheads I've been searching for years to find the perfect cleanser. One that hydrates but still deeply cleans my skin. I finally found it. When washing this cleanser off my face, I felt how soft and hydrated it was while it was still feeling squeaky clean. If you are looking for a cleanser that doesn't leave your skin feeling super dry, this is it! I 100% recommend this product.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use this product to remove my make up. Make up comes off so easily, including my eye makeup. It makes my face feel so smooth and moisturized afterwards. I love it!

avis.titre: I will never buy any make up remover
avis.texte: I use this product every single day at the end of every day and it's super easy and gets everything off my face from the day. Super moisturizing and leaves my skin super baby soft!!

This is one of the best cleansers and makeup removes I've found. I usually use the Lancome comfort face wash with the pink lettering(can't remember the name), but decided to switch to this since it's much larger(though the small one of the other normally lasts me almost a year). My skin is prone to dryness,flaking,and irritation, especially as the colder months roll around. I use this at night as a makeup remover and cleanser and ot noticeably shrinks my pores and makes my skin silky smooth,soft,and hydrated. I of course still use toner and moisturizer afterwards, but I no longer need to wear a daily moisturizing mask or heavy cream to bed. I wake up still with smooth, clean and clear looking skin. I have sensitive skin and this is non-irritating; it's actually soothing. In the AM I use Hada Labo Gokujyun cream cleanser which feels very nice, but I love this so much that I'm considering fully switching over for winter. Definitely recommend for dry,sensitive,flaky,cold- irritated, or mature skin. It has a scent(almondy), but it isn't very strong. Cleans well without stripping oils, feels like lotion, great gentle makeup remover and cleanser.

This cleanser is fantastic. I have sensitive skin and get dry patches than itch and burn with other cleansers. It has a light scent which is pleasant. I like that I can either rinse off or use a cotton pad to remove. Leaves your skin soft and moisturized after using. Love it!!

I have rosacea and need something mild. This cleanser is perfect! It's creamy, soft and effective but doesn't strip your skin of moisture. It even breaks down mascara! It has a clean, light fragrance. I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Not sure i will buy this again
avis.texte: Clean makeup off at night. Not so easy to remove with tissue. Burns and irritates my eyes. Took 2 days for my eyes to stop burning.

I use this every night to remove my makeup, it even takes off stubborn mascara. My face feels clean and soft. I use three pumps and massage gently onto my face and eyes then remove with a wet washcloth. Stuff is awesome!!

avis.titre: Yes I will be purchasing this product
avis.texte: Wash my face with his at night leaves my face feeling very moisturized and cleaned

avis.titre: OBSESSED- amazing for my dry and sensitive skin
avis.texte: LOVE!!! I typically use this at night to take off my makeup. It literally MELTS the makeup away. I apply 1-2 pumps then rinse or wipe away with warm cloth or disposable wipe. It removes makeup and cleans without drying your skin. It smells WONDERFUL and I look forward to taking off my makeup. My skin is dry-sensitive and occasionally combination so I am thoroughly impressed that this smells so lovely and soothes the skin with no irritation. My husband compliments me that I smell nice when I climb into bed after nightly skincare routine. My skin feels GREAT and no tight or dry feeling I often get with other cleansers. It is moisturizing but does not leave you greasy. The packaging is lovely as well. My NEW fave for aging, dry, and even sensitive skin!! It truly is comforting!!
I use this cleaner in the morning and a Foam cleaner in the evening so I don't have to use it twice to get all my make up off

avis.titre: I like but not what i really wanted in a cleanser.
avis.texte: I am a budget buyer but also brand if I know its a good brand and good for my skin.
The best cleanser ever!!! I have dry skin and this cleanser is my Holy Grail.

avis.titre: I will buy this product again - love love love it
avis.texte: I use it morning and evening to cleanse. I have dry skin and this product moisturizes and hydrates. There is nothing bad about this product
I am just starting to use this line. So far I have been pleased.
Best face wash I've purchased in a while. I love that it comes in such a big bottle

avis.titre: I've used this cleanser for over thirty years.  I love it!
avis.texte: I like the fact that I can use this product in the morning, and night to remove all traces of makeup without leaving the skin feeling too dry or irritated. I trust this product very much, and I remember when I first discovered it some time in 1982.

avis.titre: I'm in love with this product
avis.texte: I use this product morning and evening, for my dry skin ,it's so good and gentl, I love it ,I recommend for any one have dry skin to use it ,it's help a lot , Make your face soft moisturizing . Any one they use it they gonna love it .👍

avis.titre: I love this product, works great on my dry skin
avis.texte: My skin is super dry and this product won't dry more than what actually is. Most of the products I've used itches my skin real but this one works great on me.

avis.titre: I will always buy this product.
avis.texte: This product definitely removes all makeup and yet your face feels soft.

avis.titre: I only buy this to wash my face.
avis.texte: Only use this product to wash my face. When Ulta has a great deal, this time I received five times my points on my purchase. I buy the large bottle and I'll be good until the next deal comes around 😃

avis.titre: So much perfume it can't be good for your skin
avis.texte: This was recommended as an alternative to my usual organic face wash by the sales person. It's not bad but the amount of perfume used in this product is disgusting. I can't stand the smell but I'm used to a gentler, non-perfumed cleanser. Will NOT buy this again...I hate it!

avis.titre: Love how my skin feels after using this!
avis.texte: When I asked for help changing foundation brands in a department store, the associate used this cleanser to remove what I was wearing from a small area so she could color match the choices. I liked it immediately and asked her to add it to my purchase. I love how easy it is to use, and the first night I could feel a difference in how soft and moisturized my skin felt after removing my makeup. So glad to see that Ulta carries it.

This product does remove makeup well but leaves my skin feeling oily. What helps with the oil residue is I rinse my face off with Luke warm water after use. My skin does look youthful from using this product.

Okay, I see this face wash has a couple good reviews, but for me it just does not work. I've had it for a while, never been impressed. It doesn't effectively take off make up...I've washed my face 3 times and still have traces of makeup. It also dries my skin out, which isn't good when it's for dry skin and also not cheap. I'm honestly getting better feeling, CLEAN skin with much cheaper products.

I use this daily. I love how fast and easy this is. I just rub it on and then wipe it off with a washcloth. Fast is a necessity when you have a 3 year old and a 6 month old. My husband has used it and he loved it too.

I quit using soap on my face over thirty years ago. When I worked with cosmetic promotions as a visual merchandiser for Belk, I was given a sample of Galatee. I have never found another product that I want to use on my face. It removes my makeup, and it moisturizes my face. No tight feeling like soap or other cleansers. It is gentle, and I LOVE IT!
